description: Evaluation questions for the cricket agent. Questions with a 'check' block are verified deterministically against the real database by tests/test_eval_stats.py (no LLM involved); their expected values were computed with direct SQL, independent of the stats code under test. Questions without a 'check' are exercised only by the LLM-in-the-loop eval (tests/test_llm_eval.py, run explicitly: pytest -m llm). Values were captured against data/cricket.duckdb as ingested at the time the file was created -- re-ingesting with newer raw data will shift them, and that is exactly the signal the eval is meant to give.

questions.question: How many matches are in the dataset?

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM matches

questions.question: How many deliveries (balls) are in the dataset?

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM deliveries

questions.question: How many distinct tournaments or competitions are covered?

args.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event_name) AS n FROM matches WHERE event_name IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How many run-outs are there in the dataset?

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM deliveries WHERE wicket_kind = 'run out'

questions.question: How many runs has Virat Kohli scored in men's cricket?
How many balls has Virat Kohli faced in men's cricket?
How many times has Virat Kohli been dismissed in men's cricket?
How many sixes has Virat Kohli hit in men's cricket?
How many fours has Virat Kohli hit in men's cricket?
In how many matches has Virat Kohli batted in men's cricket?
How many wickets did Lasith Malinga take in men's cricket?
questions.expected_answer: 695 wickets (credited to the bowler; run-outs excluded).

questions.question: How many legal deliveries did Lasith Malinga bowl in men's cricket?
How many runs did Sachin Tendulkar score in men's cricket?
How many runs has David Warner scored in men's cricket?
What is the head-to-head record between India and Australia?
questions.expected_answer: 228 matches: India 88 wins, Australia 114 wins, 26 draws/no-results.

questions.question: How many matches have been played at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium?
What is the highest innings total at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium?
What is the average first-innings total at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium?
How many IPL matches are in the dataset?

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM matches WHERE event_name = 'Indian Premier League'

questions.question: How many women's matches are in the dataset?

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM matches WHERE gender = 'female'

questions.question: Who has scored the most runs in the IPL?
Who has the best death-overs economy in the IPL?
questions.expected_answer: A specific bowler named with an economy figure for overs 17-20 of IPL matches.

questions.question: Who has taken the most wickets in men's T20 internationals?
questions.expected_answer: A specific bowler named with a wicket count for match_type IT20, gender male.

questions.question: Compare Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma's batting averages in the IPL.
questions.expected_answer: Both averages stated with a comparison, ideally with a chart.

questions.question: How has Virat Kohli's IPL run-scoring trended season by season?
questions.expected_answer: A per-season breakdown, ideally with a line chart.

questions.question: Which batter has the best average in men's Test cricket with at least 20 innings?
questions.expected_answer: A specific batter named with an average, with the qualification filter applied.

questions.question: What is the head-to-head record between India and Pakistan in men's ODIs?
questions.expected_answer: Played/won counts for both teams in match_type ODI, gender male.

questions.question: Which venue has hosted the most matches?
questions.expected_answer: Dubai International Cricket Stadium with 388 matches.

questions.question: How does Virat Kohli fare against Rashid Khan?
questions.expected_answer: A matchup summary: balls faced, runs, dismissals.

questions.question: What is the most common dismissal type in the dataset?
Which team has won the most matches in the dataset?
questions.expected_answer: A specific team named with a win count.

questions.question: Who was named player of the match most often?
questions.expected_answer: A specific player named with a count.

questions.question: What is the highest team total in an IPL match?
questions.expected_answer: A total of 263 or higher with the team named.

questions.question: How many players are in the dataset?
questions.expected_answer: A count of distinct players from players_matches.

questions.question: What is the average number of wides per match in T20s?
questions.expected_answer: A small number, roughly between 3 and 8, computed by grouping deliveries by match.

questions.question: Who has taken the most catches in men's international cricket?
questions.expected_answer: A specific fielder named with a catch count.
